answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a sequential computational voyage: each new identity must solve a chain of rising-difficulty hash puzzles that embed the epoch beacon. The final puzzle seeds a short original sonnet whose lexical fingerprint is checked on-ledger against prior submissions. Clones collapse because they share the same ivory-smooth reuse pattern. An attacker therefore pays non-parallelizable sequential CPU time per head plus a bond that is slashed on failed novelty.
